plainTranslation: Their familiar patterns press against how you present yourself and enter situations, so old expectations can conflict with the way you want to show up now.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their familiar patterns press against how you present yourself and enter situations, so old expectations can conflict with the way you want to show up now.
summaryDeep: Their familiar patterns press against how you present yourself and enter situations, so old expectations can conflict with the way you want to show up now. You may feel pulled into a role that is recognizable but limiting, or become defensive when they respond to you through what already feels known. The conflict can expose repetition, but it does not prove a past-life bond or require either person to continue it.
